text: おんせんで　からだを　なおすことを　とうじ　って　いうんだぞ
note: Tōji (湯治) is a real Japanese tradition of staying at a hot spring, often for days or weeks, to treat illness or injury. The English line drops the word and only says soaking is therapeutic.
claim: Tōji (湯治) is a traditional Japanese practice of extended stays at hot springs for medical treatment.

check.quote: 湯治（とうじ）とは、温泉地に長期間（少なくとも一週間以上）滞留して特定の疾病の温泉療養を行う行為である。
